name: Hag, Moon
body:
MOON HAG
CR 8

This frail woman’s form is surrounded by silvery light, as though the moon has decided to shine only on her.

XP 4,800
CE Medium monstrous humanoid
Init +4; Senses darkvision 60’, scent; Perception +14

DEFENSE

AC 21, touch 15, flat-footed 16 (+1 dodge, +4 Dex, +6 natural)
hp 105 (10d10+50)
Fort +12, Ref +11, Will +8
Defensive Abilities silver immunity; SR 21

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee 2 claws +14 (1d6+3 plus 1d2 Charisma drain)
Ranged lunar blast +14 touch 5d6+5 plus blindness (DC 19)
Special Attacks lunar blast
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 10th; concentration +14)

At will—darkness, detect magic, detect good, detect law, faerie fire
1/day—confusion (DC 18), deep slumber (DC 17), dominate person (DC 19), greater hag’s touch* (DC 19), shadow conjuration (DC 18), shadow evocation (DC 19)

STATISTICS

Str 16, Dex 18, Con 20, Int 11, Wis 13, Cha 19
Base Atk +10; CMB +13; CMD 28
Feats Blind-Fight, Dodge, Grandmother’s Nose*, Iron Will, Weapon Focus (claws)
Skills Bluff +14, Disguise +14, Knowledge (religion) +10, Perception +14
Languages Common, Giant

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Lunar Blast (Su)

Focusing the light stored in her body, a moon hag can strike out at a target within 60 feet. Infected lycanthropes struck by the beam immediately transform as though exposed to the full moon (DC 19 Fort negates). Anyone else is blinded for one hour (DC 19 Fort negates). The save DC is Charisma-based.

Lunar Form (Sp)

While under the light of the moon, the moon hag can use polymorph at will to change her own shape. The effect lasts until she dismisses it or she is no longer under the moon’s light.

Silver Immunity (Su)

A moon hag takes no damage from silver weapons. This does not include weapons that count as silver for the purposes of DR, only weapons made out of alchemical silver, mithral, silver, and related substances.

ECOLOGY

Environment any land
Organization solitary, pack (1 plus 1-10 werewolves), or coven (any three hags)
Treasure standard

Moon hags see themselves as reflections of the ever-changing moon. While other hags work to satisfy their own hungers, moon hags hear a voice from the moon or perhaps from deep inside their own minds. That voice urges them to tear down societies, families, and relationships, leaving each humanoid dead or disconnected and alone.

Despite their disruptive urges, moon hags often fall in with covens of witches or packs of lycanthropes. Over the long term, however, the moon hag insists on being revered as a prophet if not an actual goddess. Only other hags receive a moon hag’s blessing as an equal and, even then, moon hags often find ways to wrestle for dominance within a coven.

Covens including moon hags gain control water and insanity in addition to their normal spell-like abilities.
